Yummy Korean restaurant with great service
Dec 2022 • Friends
We were in Lotte Centre and randomly walked in and were pleasantly surprised.

We ordered the BBQ pork belly and the fried glass noodles. Both were tasty and the quality of the meat and the lettuce wrap wrap are very good I have to say. 

Service was impeccable - the waitress helped us to grill the meat and the ventilation was good that we didn’t smell BBQ when we left the restaurant. Would highly recommend this restaurant if you fancy Korean in Hanoi.

Authentic Korean BBQ !!!!! (Don't miss out)
Jan 2021
This spot completely below my mind. UNLIKE gogi-house & king-BBQ, BORNGA offers the highest quality meat. More importantly they give unlimited sides and condiments.

If you are craving for a great Korean grill BBQ night .... go here, and I assure you will NOT regret it nor will will you ever again go to another grill spot.

Beyond the quality of the meat you will be amazed about the quality of service from the staff there. The staff are INCREDIBILE.

It's great in every way....... food, service, value, experience etc.......

authentic korean restaurant. good quality ingredients.
Sep 2019 • Family
i tried this place three times in my six days in hanoi. side dishes were perfect to my taste, not too salty not oily, daily prepared. main course dishes were made with fresh ingredients (both meat and seafood) and tasted like fine restaurants in seoul or los angeles koreatown. if the prices are acceptable, i would give this place a try and you won't leave disappointed. head chef is korean (in fact, he approached us and asked how the food was) and he seems to micro-manage (in terms of food preparation) which is good for the customers.

Best Korean BBQ in SE Asia
Sep 2018 • Family
Located in Lotte Center Hanoi 6th floor. Should try the BBQ style, it's the best in town. A must Lunch & dinner time for korean in Hanoi. When you are bored of raw foods or daily regular foods, should try the bbq on weekends. One of the best in town, comes with free salads, kimchi, fried fish & green tea very worth a try. Excellent ambience for expats, good for spend before or after shopping in lotte. Good luck..!!!
